responsibility: Declares channel-based decimal text I/O for REAL values in the gm2 ISO library. It specifies reading signed fixed or floating-point text from a supplied IOChan channel and writing REALs in floating, engineering, fixed, or width-adaptive forms, using the shared channel read-result conventions to report format, range, line, and end-of-input conditions.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the ISO interface for channel-based REAL text I/O, declaring the read and write procedures and their formatting modes. The paired RealIO.mod file performs the actual scanning from channels, strtod conversion, read-result setting, and string-based output formatting.
